fixedBefore: Fixed after inspecting the format of two N-PORT documents (SPY 2026-06-30, IWV 2019-09-30) and the filing inventory, before any membership, mapping or coverage result was computed.
member: A position is an index member when it is common/preferred equity held long in shares: N-PORT assetCat EC, payoffProfile Long, units NS, valUSD > 0 (money-market/collateral STIV, derivatives DE, cash excluded). In report schedules (N-30D, N-30B-2, N-Q) every line of the common-stock section with a share count and a value.

validation.NPORT: VALID when (sum of member valUSD) / netAssets is within [0.98, 1.01] (an index fund holds its net assets in index equities; up to 2 % may be equitized cash via futures) AND the member count lies in expectedPositions. Otherwise the date is NOT_VALIDATED and counted, never used.
validation.REPORT: VALID when the parsed member values sum to the reported section total (Total Common Stocks / Total Investments in securities of the fund's schedule) within +-1 %, AND the member count lies in expectedPositions. When the document reports no section total the date is NOT_VALIDATED (TOTAL_NOT_FOUND).
validation.duplicates: One date per fund: the original filing; an amendment replaces it only if the original fails validation and the amendment passes.

nameNormalization: upper case; '&' -> ' AND '; drop text after '/' when it is '/THE' or a state suffix; remove punctuation; drop leading 'THE'; drop trailing legal-form tokens repeatedly (INC, INCORPORATED, CORP, CORPORATION, CO, COMPANY, LTD, LIMITED, PLC, LLC, LP, NV, SA, AG, SE; HOLDINGS and GROUP are kept), move share-class tokens (CLASS/CL + letter) into a separate class tag and drop filler tokens (COM, COMMON, STOCK, SHS, ORD, NEW, ADR); collapse spaces.

matching.candidates: Our listings: securityId with a weekly series in quant/data/market/discover-series-long; names from quant/data/market/security-master/company-names.json (companyName and the SEC_COMPANY_TICKERS / TIINGO candidate names); ticker -> securityId only via core/identity.js#securityIdForTicker (ADR-001).
matching.priceCheck: raw holding price p = value / shares at the holding date d; series close c = weekly close of the ISO week containing d (split-adjusted); split factor f = product of the series' provider split factors with date > d, computed with quant/engines/return-series.js#splitFactors (ADR-002); ratio r = p / (c * f). A candidate is PRICE_CONFIRMED for a position key when the median |r - 1| over all dates with a bar is <= 0.05 and at least one date has a bar.

tiers.T1_CUSIP_NAME_EXACT: N-PORT position key (CUSIP) whose normalized name or title equals the normalized name of exactly one PRICE_CONFIRMED candidate.
tiers.T2_NAME_UNIQUE: no CUSIP (report schedules) or no exact name: exactly one candidate whose normalized name equals (report) or whose token-set similarity >= 0.9 is unique and which is PRICE_CONFIRMED.
tiers.T3_UNCERTAIN: name candidates exist but none or more than one is PRICE_CONFIRMED, or the share class is ambiguous; NOT used.
tiers.UNMATCHED: no candidate listing; counted as missing coverage.

matching.use: Only T1 and T2 mappings enter the register's securityId field and the coverage.

coverage.loader: createResearchLoader(root, {identityEvidence: true, corporateActionEvidence: true, listingLifecycleEvidence: true})
coverage.covered: member mapped (T1/T2) to a securityId that the loader returns without error (QUALIFIED) and whose returned points contain a bar within 7 calendar days of the holding date (inside first..last bar).
coverage.measures: per fund and date: share of members (count) and of member value (weight) covered
coverage.qualifiedSubpopulationThreshold: a fund-date qualifies when coverage >= 95 % of members AND >= 99 % of weight; a period qualifies when every validated date in it qualifies

exits: A member key (securityId when mapped T1/T2, else CUSIP, else normalized name) present at date t and absent at every later validated date of the same fund. Fate from SEC submissions of the issuer CIK (Form 25/25-NSE, 15-12B/15-12G/15-15D, 8-K item 2.01) within 400 days after the last holding date; STILL_REPORTING when 10-K/10-Q filings continue more than 400 days later.
quarterPrices: For members without covered series: p = value / shares per date (raw, unadjusted, as reported). Plausibility measured on members with both: |r - 1| distribution per date, exact-week-end dates reported separately.
